svg.text: TestPulse for Jira — what the product is, and what is and is not complete
003-MoPr010-testpulse_atlassian · v035 released 20/09/2026 · diagram issue V001 · every status below is as recorded in the sprint tracker, not estimated
COMPLETE — built and proven by a test or a standing gate
CODE-COMPLETE — works in code; the claim needs a live site
NOT COMPLETE — blocked on a person, a purchase or procurement
PLATFORM / EXTERNAL — not ours to build
HOW IT WORKS — one request, end to end
Jira issue panel
Forge Custom UI, five tabs
Cases · Runs · Flaky · Readiness · Settings
Jira project page
Project-level listing across issues
Same bundle, different default view
CI pipeline (customer's)
JUnit · Playwright · Cucumber
Posts to the web trigger
Scheduled trigger (daily)
Retention sweep · 30-day hard delete
Declared in the manifest
Resolver — forge/index.ts + makeHandlers
Every call declares a CALL_SCOPE · roles derived server-side, never from the caller
Licence gate: inactive → read-only, reads never blocked
Web trigger (static)
HMAC-SHA256 + timestamp, 5-min replay
One dedupe key per event id · 1 MiB cap
Lifecycle trigger
avi:forge:installed / uninstalled:app
Bootstrap, wipe credentials, schedule delete
Project-scoped permission check — asUser() BROWSE_PROJECTS on every project-scoped read and write
Fails closed: an unanswered check is a denial. App visibility can never exceed Jira visibility.
DOMAIN MODULES
Case generation
Rule engine always
AI optional, off by
default
Run boards
Pass / fail / blocked
Default board on demand
Flaky detection
Flip rate, clusters
Branch-aware quarantine
Readiness score
Derived, not typed
Every factor names its
source
Traceability
Requirement → case →
run → defect, queryable
CI ingestion
Three adapters
Idempotent by run id
Connector health
never / healthy /
stale / rejecting
Data rights + audit
Owner export & delete
Audit log, project-scoped
Storage seam — ForgeStore
Every value in a versioned envelope {__tpv, v}, written with compare-and-set · commutative ops (append / increment / union / setIfAbsent / update) re-applied at flush
Per-entity keys — one key per case, run, result, link · prefix-scoped hydration, one round trip per 100 keys · 200 KiB budget under the 240 KiB platform ceiling
Forge KVS — the shipped backend
240 KiB per value · query pages of 100 · no conditional write, so CAS is read-verify-write
Forge SQL — built, not enabled
Atomic CAS, migrations applied per install · enabling it is a MAJOR version bump · decision D19,
deferred to the live install
WHAT LEAVES ATLASSIAN
Jira REST — read only
read:jira-work, as the calling user
Backoff + one shared circuit breaker
No write scope is requested at all
api.anthropic.com — optional
The only external host in the manifest
Off by default; redacted, capped, audited
Its presence forfeits the Runs-on-Atlassian badge
Nothing else
No email transport, no analytics host
No Atlassian credential is ever stored
A tenant key lives in Forge Secret Storage
WHAT IS NOT COMPLETE — and why
COMPLETE: 66 of 95 planned tasks
Built with a pinned regression test. 55 suites / 530 tests / 100% branches, functions, lines and
statements; seven standing gates; zero production dependencies.
BLOCKED ON A LIVE JIRA SITE — 10 items
Install and bootstrap · forge eligibility output · that extension.issue.key reaches the panel · real KVS
latency, cold start and panel p75 · project isolation on a restricted project · LC-6 evidence · entitlement
against a real licence · re-running the envelope · concurrent tenants and 25s headroom · closing the 15
pending-live stories. WHY: it needs an Atlassian account and a browser. Prepared to a 45-minute run sheet; none
of it can be produced by writing more code.
BLOCKED ON A PERSON — 7 items
Ten design partners · the ST-100 validation interviews · three real customer export files · driving the loop by
hand · generation-QUALITY evals · the kill/continue evidence pack · three teams making a documented go/no-go
call. WHY: fixtures cannot stand in for a real customer's export, and generation quality can only be scored
against stories a real team wrote. The kit is shipped and waiting.
BLOCKED ON PROCUREMENT — 2 items
CREST penetration test · public bug bounty (AEC 1.1 / 1.2). WHY: external parties with lead times measured in
weeks. Recorded explicitly that publishing a security.md and a contact address does NOT satisfy the
requirement; the internal assessment is complete and is not a substitute.
BLOCKED ON A PURCHASE — 3 items
Convert to per-user tiers · configure in the partner console · complete a test purchase. WHY: needs the
Marketplace partner console and a real purchase flow. The pricing is already rewritten in per-user terms
against the corrected 0% revenue share, anchored 40-50% under Xray in the 26-200 seat band.
BLOCKED ON A DECISION — 2 items
Jira write-back (D-TP-WB) · who gets paged. WHY: each changes what the product is, so neither is Claude's to
take. Write-back would re-add a Jira write scope, which must be a justified feature with a named call path and
never a silent permission. Forge SQL enablement (D19) sits behind the same rule as a MAJOR version.
THE REMAINING 5 — each pending for its own reason
A week of real CI traffic for back-pressure · 30 days of live data before an SLO is defined rather than chosen
· extension.issue.key, which no compiler can close because the vendor type is an open map · porting the
concurrency gate to the other 11 products · and one row that is correctly NOT APPLICABLE, because no
installation exists to migrate duplicate ids from.
AND ONE THING THAT IS COMPLETE AND STILL A NO
The Runs on Atlassian badge is assessed from the MANIFEST, continuously — not from runtime behaviour. Declaring
api.anthropic.com disqualifies the app whether or not any tenant ever enables AI, so switching AI off does not
earn it. Three options are documented; the decision is open.
THE ARITHMETIC — 95 planned tasks, counted from the sprint tracker
Done in code
Built with a pinned regression test in the
suite.
Open — needs LC-1
Waiting on one live install, not on
engineering.
Open — Senthil
A person, a purchase, or procurement.
Other open
One decision, one portfolio rollout, two
partials, one not applicable, one needs
partners.
Read these three numbers together
Sixty-six done in code is not sixty-six done. A task is Done when there is evidence from a live system, and two
statuses previously published as Done were DOWNGRADED to Open on 20/09 for exactly that reason.
The release position has been unchanged and correct since v010: NOT RELEASE READY until LC-1.
THREE THINGS THIS PICTURE IS NOT HIDING
The re-platform cost round trips.
Per-entity keys removed the row ceiling that was the disqualifier, and replaced it with a round-trip cost:
102 storage round trips for a 10,000-run board, 500 for a 50,000-case site-wide listing. The hot path — one
story's cases — is 1.
The financial model does not break even inside 18 months.
Even after correcting the marketplace fee in our favour (0% until $1M lifetime Forge revenue), the model
does not reach breakeven within 18 months at a $20k/month team cost. That was published rather than
reworked until it did.
Operational evidence scores 1 out of 10.
The most recent external review moved four of its six scores upward and left this one where it was. Nothing
has run on a real site, and no amount of code changes that number.
